status: REGISTERED, NOT RUN. Committed before the first E24 diagnostic round per PS-01-D1.
title: Why has the BOINC QLoRA-MoE chain increased held-out loss since round hmq_00171, and which intervention restores non-positive median per-domain held-out loss change over a 20-round window?

constraints.evaluation_invariance_check: Same held-out shards, same RNG seed, and identical base weights before and after each round must be verified first via E24_A0_control_replay_round_170.

design.unit_of_comparison: 20-round window starting from the round-170 (hmq_00170) checkpoint on the six core domains (general, french, edu_web, news, biomed, math).

E24_A0_control_replay_round_170.description: Replay evaluation of the round-170 (hmq_00170) adapter unchanged before and after a no-op round to confirm zero evaluation drift (exact 0.0 nats delta across all domains).

E24_A1_ratchet_acceptance_rule.description: Require the outer ratchet to gate acceptance on pooled multi-domain held-out evaluation (median per-domain change <= 0 and share_worse <= 0.50) rather than single-shard training loss.

E24_A2_single_domain_work_units.description: Reduce inner steps per single-domain workunit from 80 to 20 with outer EMA interpolation (beta=0.5) so single-domain updates cannot overwrite orthogonal domain subspaces.

E24_A3_stratified_mixing.description: Construct each workunit shard by stratified sampling across all 6 core domains in equal token proportions with fixed held-out exclusion.

metrics.primary_metric: median_change_nats: median across domains of (held_out_loss_after - held_out_loss_before) in nats
metrics.secondary_metric: share_worse: fraction of evaluated domains where (held_out_loss_after - held_out_loss_before) > 0

decision_rule.eval_sanity_gate: E24_A0_control_replay_round_170 must show max_abs_noop_delta_nats <= 1e-6 before any candidate arm is interpreted.
decision_rule.arm_success_criterion: Over a pre-registered window of at least 20 consecutive rounds, median_change_nats <= 0.0 AND share_worse <= 0.50.

outcomes.CAUSE_ATTRIBUTED: At least one candidate arm (E24_A1, E24_A2, or E24_A3) satisfies arm_success_criterion while reproducing the post-hmq_00171 regression when its mechanism is reverted.
outcomes.ALL_REFUTED: E24_A0 passes eval_sanity_gate, but none of E24_A1, E24_A2, or E24_A3 satisfies arm_success_criterion over the registered window.

not_claimed: No E24 diagnostic round has been executed in this pre-registration file.
Decoupled DiLoCo learner/synchroniser alignment is deferred until E24 attributes or refutes the three candidate causes.
